summary: UTime Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of independent director Hailin Xie effective August 25, 2026, citing personal reasons with no disagreement with management. The board appointed Zhenhong Li, 33, to fill the vacancies as independent director, compensation committee chair, and audit and governance committee member. Mr. Li will receive $36,000 annually, paid monthly in cash or stock. The resignation and appointment are routine board changes, not forced or abrupt, but the filing explicitly covers director turnover. There is no deal structure or special-situation angle beyond standard governance; watch for subsequent board stability or related party disclosures.
